comment: ELEMENT FORMS. Written because the F6 fixture-coverage gate reported `style_element` and `self_closing_tag` as two of twelve HANDLED node types that no fixture exercised — the gate catching a gap in the lane's OWN fixtures, which is what it is for. A handled type nothing pins is a type whose handling can rot silently. Both tag containers (`start_tag` and `self_closing_tag`) therefore need a pin, as does the void-element form the grammar shapes the other way.

expectRelationships.comment: A self-closing tag goes through the OTHER container cursor, and the resource it declares must still be read — a self-closing carrier that produced nothing would be the same class of miss as the eight the rule table recovered.
An SVG self-closing element is the common real case, and the nearest addressable ancestor is the `<svg>`, not the document.
`rel=canonical` is in the fetchable-`rel` vocabulary, so the edge says WHICH kind of link it is rather than only that a link exists.
An XHTML-style self-closing NON-void element: the grammar must not require an end tag for it.

forbidRelationships.comment: A viewport meta is a declaration, not a fetched resource — `content` is a value here, not a URL.

The inline <style> BODY is the lane's one open completeness gap (HTML-G1, `raw_text`): the element is a node, but nothing descends into its CSS, so the rule it declares is not an edge. Pinned as an explicit absence so the gap cannot be closed silently — when HTML-G1 lands this row must be revisited, not deleted.
